costFunding.heading: Registration
costFunding.detail: SHPE prices in tiers: early-bird (through ~mid-September), regular (through ~mid-October), then late through the convention. Student-member early-bird ran about $480 in 2025 — confirm the 2026 rate on shpe.org. Registration covers the career fair, workshops, competitions, and conference programming.

costFunding.heading: Travel & lodging
costFunding.detail: BU SHPE travels as a group: coordinated flights from Boston and a hotel block near the Indiana Convention Center. The chapter applies a subsidy per registered delegate — exact amounts depend on funding each year (chapter records).

costFunding.heading: Funding sources
costFunding.detail: Member cost is offset by chapter fundraising, BU College of Engineering / Student Activities support, and corporate sponsorship. The specific per-member breakdown is set by the e-board each year (chapter records).

eligibility: Active BU SHPE member in good standing
Enrolled BU undergraduate or graduate student
Completed the delegation interest form by the deadline

faq.q: Do I need to be an engineering major?
faq.a: No — SHPE welcomes all STEM majors and all class standings. The career fair recruits across engineering, computing, and the sciences.

Full conference access: the STEM career fair (150+ companies recruiting onsite), technical and leadership workshops, the competitions, and specialty tracks for community-college, graduate, professional, and tech audiences.

The chapter travels as a group and subsidizes registration, flights, and lodging for registered delegates. The exact subsidy depends on funding each year — watch the mailing list for the current offer.

faq.q: I've never been to a convention. Is it for me?
faq.a: Especially for you. We run a prep bootcamp beforehand and travel as a group — first-timers are the reason the prep track exists.

faq.q: When do I need to commit?
faq.a: Register before the early-bird deadline (about mid-September) for the best rate. Watch the key-dates timeline above and the chapter mailing list for the locked delegation calendar.
